summary: Adds renovate.json (schedule, dashboard approval for majors, version-catalog pins by sharedVariableName, disabled entries, GitHub actions grouping) and a workflow that validates the config and checks the pinned catalog aliases still exist.

tests.evidence: Configuration only; verified by a local renovate dry-run and the alias check in CI, no unit tests owed.

doc_comments.evidence: Rule descriptions and workflow comments are extensive and mostly match the config; the one mismatch is counted under contradictions.

change_description.evidence: Long, well-reasoned description; it was later extended with the cooldown paragraph but was not deficient for the submitted change.

security.evidence: Supply-chain policy: msridhar asked for a 7-day cooldown against broken/hacked releases, added later as minimumReleaseAge with exemptions (final renovate.json); CodeRabbit also flagged the unpinned renovate/renovate:latest image run with the checkout mounted (kept deliberately, justified in a comment).

concurrency.evidence: Workflow copies the concurrency group #1818 settled on.

error_model.evidence: The alias-check script's core.setFailed messages name the missing aliases; a glance suffices.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial matching logic (matchJsonata on sharedVariableName, Gradle ranges, groupName vs group:monorepos) plus a JS alias checker; CodeRabbit found the Error Prone 'at any time' rule does not override dependencyDashboardApproval for majors, so Error Prone majors still wait for approval.

user_value.evidence: Maintainer-facing automation; reviewer debated whether manual approval for majors is worth it and kept it 'to see how annoying it is'.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Every major across managers goes to the dashboard; description states it.

contradictions.evidence: Error Prone rule description says PRs 'open as soon as a release lands', but the global major rule still requires dashboard approval; the final version adds 'A major Error Prone release still needs dependency dashboard approval' to the description.

build_ci.evidence: New .github/workflows/renovate-config-lint.yml and renovate.json drive dependency updates and CI; the whole PR is build/dependency infrastructure.

spec_conformance.evidence: Relies on Renovate config semantics (Gradle range syntax, packageRules merging); the dashboard-approval merge issue is counted under correctness.

plan.why: Two cohesive config files; one reviewer versed in Renovate and Actions can cover supply-chain, rule logic and description consistency together.
